scope: Optional SDK audit event scope, selected/redacted body capture, encrypted JDBC audit, independently witnessed monotonic chain, scoped access audit and payload expiry; not a production WORM or IAM certification

documentation.notes: Three older anchor-link INFO messages remain outside the new guide

verification.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

collection.default: Metadata only, AuditBodyPolicy.NONE; no traversal of the original target in disabled mode
collection.scope: HostSession supplies real tenantId/principalId/taskId/sessionId; body claims and trace identifiers do not define authorization
collection.selection: Explicit intervention points and top-level fields, separate text opt-in, recursively applied custom exclusions
collection.redaction: Unicode NFKC field normalization, credential/header/cookie exclusions, Bearer/API-key/credential-assignment patterns and parsing embedded JSON text
collection.omission: Input, projection or UTF-8 storage limits omit the whole body with a machine reason; no incomplete unredacted prefix
collection.limits: Input <=1048576 characters, stored body <=65536 bytes, <=64 selected/excluded fields; lifecycle bodies refused
collection.semantics: Original/effective intervention-target projection is captured, not raw Provider HTTP wire data; business input/result is not rewritten by audit capture
collection.privacyLimit: Pattern masking is not universal secret or PII detection; host selection/classification remains required

coreIntegration.sink: AuditSink remains functional for legacy record lambdas; default event method refuses collected body when the sink cannot accept an event
coreIntegration.snapshot: AgentControl freezes the declared body policy at construction
coreIntegration.failure: Audit write or witness failure poisons runtime admission; pre-tool audit failure prevents business callback
coreIntegration.otel: AgentTracer.correlate forwards scope/eventId/body/bodyPolicy and close while attaching actual execution context

storage.encryption: JDK JCA AES-256-GCM with fresh 96-bit random nonce and 128-bit tag; separate metadata/body AAD binds catalog, stream, sequence, event id, key id, kind, retention and fingerprint
storage.integrity: HMAC-SHA256 using a distinct key authenticates catalog, head and linked event headers/ciphertext digests
storage.keys: Host supplies reviewed versioned keys; only key ids stored in database; old versions remain necessary for historical verification
storage.bounds: <=10000 entries per subject stream, <=64MiB retained ciphertext configured cap, 64KiB SDK-write reserve for administrative events, JDBC statement timeout 1..30s
storage.algorithmScope: Standard algorithms used directly; not a cryptographic protocol certification or vendor KMS/HSM verification

witness.protocol: Independent AuditWitness CAS accepts genesis or exactly one higher sequence; configured catalog/subject stream and hash must match
witness.acknowledgment: Primary transaction commit plus witness confirmation precedes successful append/record or body delivery
witness.recovery: Normal protocol permits at most one committed but unwitnessed event; verified pending entry is published without reexecuting a model/tool
witness.rollback: Main-store valid old-prefix rollback is refused against newer witness; missing witness and witness lag greater than one are refused rather than silently reset
witness.idempotency: Same eventId only reuses exactly matching original content, even after expiry; different content is refused
witness.trustBoundary: Production witness needs independent credentials/storage/delete permissions; controlling both databases and publisher keys is outside the guarantee

accessAndRetention.metadata: governance:audit:read, same authenticated tenant/principal only; no arbitrary target-tenant/principal parameter
accessAndRetention.body: Both read and governance:audit:body, same subject stream, unexpired content only
accessAndRetention.purge: governance:audit:purge only for already expired ciphertext in own stream
accessAndRetention.accessAudit: ACCESS event must be committed and witnessed before metadata/body is returned; read body failure does not return already internally decrypted content
accessAndRetention.expiry: Body and complete-record lifetimes differ and are authenticated; authorized accesses/purge anchor observed time so rollback does not revive expired data
accessAndRetention.purgeSemantics: Payload ciphertext erased, RETENTION event added; integrity headers, hashes, opaque event ids/type/times retained and still verifiable
accessAndRetention.remaining: No automatic cleanup daemon, complete header archive/prune protocol, backup destruction or independent crypto-erasure of old encryption keys

independentProcessEvidence.restart: H2 TCP storage restarted, fresh vault retained exact checkpoint; authorized metadata omitted body and body reader recovered selected projection

independentProcessEvidence.fault: Worker forcibly terminated after PRE_TOOL audit primary commit and before witness confirmation
independentProcessEvidence.recovery: New worker validated/published pending audit event before its own normal SDK operation; no replay of killed business callback

processEnvironment.transport: Loopback HTTP, separate primary/witness H2 logical databases, independent SDK JVMs
processEnvironment.credentials: Synthetic keys/database/HTTP credentials via stdin only, not argv or public evidence
processEnvironment.isolationLimit: Both logical databases use the same local test TCP server; production independent administrator domains, IAM and failure isolation are not certified

testClasses.AuditCaptureTest: Legacy metadata-only compatibility, scope forgery resistance, immutable policy, opt-in text, nested/Unicode/custom redaction, bounds and incorrect legacy sink refusal
testClasses.JdbcAuditVaultTest: Encrypted reopen, scoped permissions, separate TTL/purge, ciphertext/header/date/delete tampering, authentic-prefix rollback, commit/ack loss, witness reset/rollback, key rotation, concurrent creation, deterministic stale-missing-head race, byte budget and policy binding
testClasses.AuditRuntimeTest: Actual core tool admission and access-audit-before-body-delivery failures
testClasses.AuditProcessTest: Two independent SDK JVMs, storage restart and kill-at-committed-pre-audit fault
testClasses.AuditCryptoTest: JCA AEAD roundtrip, AAD rejection, ciphertext corruption and distinct sampled nonces
testClasses.AuditAdapterTest: Actual native model and supported native sync/async tool, unchanged business values and redacted storage
testClasses.AgentTracerTest: Contextual sink/capture/close forwarding plus existing OTel correlation regressions

notVerified: Production identity, cross-principal administration, approver authentication or separation of duties
Production KMS/HSM, key usage limits, certified key destruction or key rewrap/migration
Independent production witness deployment or WORM guarantees; Trillian/Tessera/immudb services not deployed
Other SQL database dialects, high-volume performance, HA/failover/disaster recovery and complete archive/prune lifecycle
Teaching TraceStore snapshot migration, browser body access management and third-party provider logs
Generic prevention against a compromised trusted publisher, both storage administrators plus key access, or all PII/encoded secret formats
